title: Meri Jaan Akbar
body:
Haye ali akbar, haye ali akbar..(2)
<<MINI>>
Bole shabbir meri jaa'n akbar
kisne maari tumhe sina akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Jisme nazuk pe itne zakhm lage
khoon behta hai tere seene se
sochta hu ke kya bataunga..(2)
kaise khaime mein leke jaunga
puch le gar tumhari maa akbar
<<MINI>>
kisne maari tumhe sina akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Sun rahe ho meri sadaa ko agar
aankhein kholo padar fida tum par
dum humara ukhadne lagta hai..(2)
saans mera bhi rukne lagta hai
tum jo lete ho hichkiya'n akbar
<<MINI>>
kisne maari tumhe sina akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Aisi halat jo dekhta hu mai
zakhm gin gin ke ro raha hu mai
kisne barchi ka phal utara hai..(2)
kisne seene pe waar maara hai
kuch to hum se karo baya'n akbar
<<MINI>>
kisne maari tumhe sina akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Tumne jab akhri sadaa di thi
meri aankho'n mein roshni na rahi
aisa sadma hai ye mere beta..(2)
tum jo rahwaar se gire beta
gir pada hum pe aasmaa'n akbar
<<MINI>>
kisne maari tumhe sina akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Baat ye bhi suno qayamat ki
tere marne ki jab khabar hai suni
mujhko fizza ne ye bataya hai..(2)
ghar mein zainab ka dum nikalta hai
jaan dete ho tum yaha'n akbar
<<MINI>>
kisne maari tumhe sina akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Tum bhi meesam sadaa padho nauhe aur tum bhi raza likho nauhe
soz e ghum aur bhi siwaa kijiye..(2)
sharf e maqbooliyat ataa kijiye
hum tumhare hai nauha khwaa akbar
<<MINI>>
kisne maari tumhe sina akbar
Bole shabbir meri jaa'n akbar
kisne maari tumhe sina akbar
